sa: जनयेद् यं सुतं सोमः सोऽस्या देव्याः पतिर्भवेत्। अग्निश्चैतैर्गुणैर्युक्तः सर्वैरग्निश्च देवता॥
en: If Soma beget a son now, that son may become the husband of this damsel. Agni has also similar surroundings. Agni is also a deity of heaven.

sa: एवं तया यथोक्तो वै गत्वा राजानमब्रवीत्। ऋतुपर्ण महाराज सुदेवो ब्राह्मणस्तदा।॥
en: O monarch, thus addressed by her, the Brahmana, Sudeva by name, started at once. He spoke to king Rituparna what he was ordered by her to do.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो हृष्टमना राजा वृहदश्वमुवाच ह। भगवन्नक्षहृदयं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon with great joy the king (Yudhishthira) thus spoke to Brihadashva, “O exalted one. I desire to learn the science of dice from you."

sa: सार्थवाहं च सार्थं च जना ये चात्र केचन। युवस्थविरबालाश्च सार्थस्य च पुरोगमाः॥ मानुषीं मां विजानीत मनुजाधिपतेः सुताम्। नृपस्नुषां राजभार्यां भर्तृदर्शनलालसाम्॥
en: "O leader of the caravan, You traders, You men that belong to this caravan! You youths, you guides of this caravan! Know me for a female human being, a daughter of a royal parent, a daughter-in-law of a sovereign, spouse of a king and as one cager to have a sight of her husband.

sa: द्यूतप्रियेण राजेन्द्र तथा तद् भवता कृतम्। प्रायेणाज्ञातचर्यायां वयं सर्वे निपातिताः॥
en: O most excellent of princes, this has been the out-come of your love for gambling. We are almost ruined by your promise to live one year undiscovered.

sa: आसन् कृतयुगे घोरा दानवा युद्धदुर्मदाः। कालकेया इति ख्याता गणाः परमदारुणाः॥
en: There in the Treta Yuga were some fearful Danavas who were invincible in battle. They were known by the name of Kalkeyas and they possessed fearful prowess.

sa: समाक्रान्ता मही पद्भ्यां समकम्पत सदुमा। क्षुभिताः सरितश्चैव तथैव च महोदधिः॥
en: The earth, being oppressed by the weight of his feet, began to tremble together with all its trees and the rivers and the mighty ocean became troubled.

sa: क्वासौ क्वासाविति मया किल रणे योद्धं काक्षमाणः स सौभराट्। ११॥
en: (Exclaiming repeatedly) Where is he! Where is he!' the lord of Saubha, being desirous of fighting with me again and again rushed hither and thither in battle.

sa: एवं निर्जित्य तरसा सान्त्वेन विजयेन च। करदान् पार्थिवान् कृत्वा प्रत्यागच्छदरिंदमः॥
en: Having vanquished by war and by, conciliation many kings and having also made them pay tribute to him, that chastiser of foes returned (to his own city).

sa: ततो वायुः प्रादुरभूदधस्तस्य महात्मनः। शब्देन महता तात गर्जन्निव यथा घनः॥
en: Thereupon, a child, (only a quantity of) wind came out of the stomach of the high-souled one with great a sound as that of the roaring clouds.

sa: सा हि मांसार्गलं भीष्म मुखात् सिंहस्य खादतः। दन्तान्तरविलग्नं यत् तदादत्तेऽल्पचेतना॥
en: O Bhishma, that foolish bird used to pick from the lion's mouth the pieces of flesh sticking between its teeth when the lion was engaged in eating.

sa: यथा मनुर्यथेक्ष्वाकुर्यथा पूरुर्महायशाः। यथा वैन्यो महाराज तथा त्वमपि विश्रुतः॥ यथा च वृत्रहा सर्वान् सपत्नान् निर्दहन् पुरा। त्रैलोक्यं पालयामास देवराड् विगतज्वरः॥ तथा शत्रुक्षयं कृत्वा त्वं प्रजाः पालयिष्यसि। स्वधर्मविजितामुर्वी प्राप्य राजीवलोचन॥ ख्यातिं यास्यसिधर्मेण कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो यथा॥
en: As were Manu, Ikshvaku the greatly famous Puru and Vena so, O great king, would you become celebrated and as in the days of yore, the slayer of Vitra, the king of the celestials after, having burnt his enemies and having his mind freed from all anxieties ruled over the three worlds, so will you destroying your enemies rule over your subjects. O lotus-eyed hero, having conquered the earth according to the custom of your own order (Kshatriya), you will acquire renown by your own virtue as did Krittaviryarjuna.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कथयिष्यामि ते तात कथामेतां महात्मनः। दिव्यां पौरवशार्दूल महतीमद्भुतोपमाम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O foremost of the Kurus, O child, I shall narrate to you the excellent, the extensive and greatly unrivalled history of that illustrious hero.

sa: ख्यातः प्राज्ञः कुलीनश्च सानुक्रोशो भवान् सदा। संवृत्तो निरनुक्रोशः शङ्के मद्भाग्यसंक्षयात्॥
en: You are well reputed, wise, respectable and always kind. But why now have you become unkind; and that is perhaps for the reason of my adverse fortune.

sa: परीक्षितो मे बहुशो बाहुको नलशङ्कया। रूपे मे संशयस्त्वेकः स्वयमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: Damayanti said: “Suspecting Bahuka to be Nala, I have examined him several times; but I have some doubt about his appearance, which I like to know myself.

sa: अद्यास्त्रमाययैतेषां मायामेतां सुदारुणाम्। विनिहन्मि तमश्चोग्रं मा भैः सूत स्थिरो भव॥
en: O charioteer do not be afraid, calm yourself. I will, this day, destroy the terrible illusion created by them and also this dense darkness, by illusion-creating weapon."

sa: तपसो यः प्रभावेण वर्षयामास वासवम्। अनावृष्ट्यां भयाद् यस्य ववर्ष बलवृत्रहा॥
en: By his ascetic prowess he made Asava (Indra) to pour rains and from whose fear the destroyer of Bala and Vitra poured down rains during a draught.

sa: मामियं हनुरक्तवं दुःखमाप्नोति मत्कृते। मद्विहीना त्वियं गच्छेत् कदाचित् स्वजनं प्रति॥
en: She is (fondly) attached unto myself. For this reason she suffer these afflictions for me. But (when) forsaken by me, she may possibly repair to her relatives.

sa: रुरुदुः सुस्वनं सर्वा विनिन्दन्त्यः कुरून् भृशम्। दध्युश्च सुचिरं कालं करासक्तमुखाम्बुजाः॥
en: Loudly wept, all greatly censuring the Kurus. The ladies of the royal household sat silent for a long time covering their lotus like faces with their hands.

sa: अनुपोष्य त्रिरात्राणि तीर्थान्यनभिगम्य च। अदत्त्वा काञ्चनं गाश्च दरिद्रो नाम जायते॥
en: He is called poor who, having gone to a Tirtha, does not fast for three nights and who does not give away gold and kine (in charity).

sa: समेत्य बहुशो देवाः सेन्द्राः सवरुणाः पुरा। विशाखयूपेऽतप्यन्त तेन पुण्यतमश्च सः॥
en: Here is also Vishakhayupa to which in the days of yore came the celestials with Indra and Varuna and practised asceticism; and thus it became so sacred.

sa: देवानां दानवानां च मांसशोणितकर्दमम्। अनयो देवलोकस्य सहसैवाभ्यदृश्यत॥ तथा हि दानवा घोरा विनिघ्नन्ति दिवौकसः। ततस्तूर्यप्रणादाश्च भेरीणां च महास्वनः॥ बभूवुर्दानवेन्द्राणां सिहनादाश्च दारुणाः। अथ दैत्यवलाद् घोरान्निष्पपात महाबलः॥ दानवो महिषो नाम प्रगृह्य विपुलं गिरिम्।
en: The battle field was covered with blood and strewn with the bodies of both the Devas and the Danavas. The celestials however, were soon worsted and the fearful Danavas again made a great havoc of the celestials army. The Asura drums were sounded and their shrill bugles were loudly blown. The Danava chiefs sent forth terrific lion-like roars. Then came forward from the fearful Danava army a greatly powerful Danava, named Mahisha with a large mass of rocks in his hands.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं प्रवतिते द्यूते घोरे सर्वापहारिणि। सर्वसंशयनिर्मोक्ता विदुरो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said During the course of this fearful gambling, which was certain to bring about utter twin, that dispeller of all doubts, Vidura, thus spoke (to Dhritarashtra).

sa: अर्जुन उवाच गाण्डीवमाश्रयं कृत्वा नाराचांश्चाग्निसंनिभान्। निवसामि महारण्ये द्वितीय इव पावकिः॥
en: Arjuna said: Depending on my Gandiva(bow) and my arrows as blazing as the fire, I live in this great forest like a second son of fire (Kartikeya).

sa: दिष्ट्या लोके पुमानस्ति कश्चिदस्मत्प्रिये स्थितः। येनास्माकं हृतो भार आसीनानां सुखावहः॥
en: There is in the world still fortunately (for us) some who is desirous of doing us good and who has taken upon his shoulder our pleasant load.

sa: साभिवाद्य तपोवृद्धान् विनयावनता स्थिता। स्वागतं त इति प्रोक्ता तैः सर्वैस्ताप्रसोत्तमैः॥
en: She, saluting those sages grown old in the practice of austerities, stood in an attitude of humility. In that forest she was offered 'welcome' by those ascetics.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा त्वरितः पार्थः शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः। उपसंगम्य विश्वेशमधीष्वेत्यथ सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard this, the son of Pritha (Arjuna) purified himself. Coming to the lord of the universe with rapt attention, he said, "Instruct me.”

sa: धूमकेतुः शिखी च त्वं पापहानिलसम्भवः। सर्वप्राणिषु नित्यस्थः सत्येन विपुनीहि माम्॥
en: O smoke-bannered deity, O possessor of flames, O deity born of Vayu, O god who is present in all creatures. Purify me by your rays of truth.

sa: त्रीणि शृङ्गाणि शुभ्राणि त्रीणि प्रस्रवणानि च। पुष्कराण्यादिसिद्धानि न विद्मस्तत्र कारणम्॥
en: There are three white hills and three springs (in Pushkara). We do not know why they are known by the name of Pushkara from the remotest time.

sa: एवं दश दिशः सर्वास्तिर्यगूर्ध्वं च भारत। नादयामासुरसुरास्ते चापि निहता मया॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, in this way the Asuras sent up roars from all the ten quarters, above and across. But they were all killed by me.

sa: अथ शुश्राव राजर्षि तमुत्तको नराधिप। वनं सम्प्रस्थितं राजन् बृहदश्वं द्विजोत्तमः॥
en: O rulers of men, O king, when the royal sage Brihadashva was about to go away into the forest, that best of Brahmanas, Uttanka, heard of it.

sa: योऽयं मूर्धाभिषिक्तानामग्रे याति परंतपः। सोऽयं पांसुषु शेतेऽद्य पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम्॥
en: See the reverses brought about by Time, this subduer of enemies that used forinerly to walk at the head of all kings now sleeps on thc dust.

sa: मयैतानि च वाक्यानि श्रावितः शोकलालसः। यानि ते यदुवीरेण कथितानि महीपते॥
en: Assailed with grief as the king was, I recounted to him all those stories, O king, that this hero of Yadu's race has already recited to you.

sa: इदं कष्टतरं पश्य पुत्रस्यापि वधान्मम। यदिमाः पर्युपासन्ते हताशूरान् रणे स्त्रियः॥
en: Again, look at this sight, of these fair ladies weeping by the side of the killed heroes, that is more painful than the death of my son.

sa: अद्य जानातु कौन्तेयं समर्थं सर्वधन्विनाम्। अद्यात्मानं च दुर्मेधा गर्हयिष्यति पापकृत्॥
en: Let him know today that the son of Kunti is the most powerful of all bowmen. Today that sinful and wicked-hearted king will blame his own self.

sa: दानेन कर्मणा चान्ये तपसान्ये तपस्विनः। बुद्ध्या दाक्ष्येण चैवान्ये विन्दन्ति धनसंचयान्॥
en: Some acquire wealth by gifts and sacrifices; some who like penances acquire the same by penances; some acquire it by the help of their intelligence and cleverness.

sa: मृगयाऽक्षाः स्त्रियः पानं प्रसङ्गा निन्दिता बुधैः। दृश्यन्ते पुरुषाश्चात्र सम्प्रयुक्ता बहुश्रुताः॥
en: Hunting, dice, women, wine, quarrels, these are censured by the wise. many persons, well, and greatly, read in the scriptures, are seen to be addicted to them.

sa: अर्थसंनिचयं कुर्याद् राजा परबलार्दितः। तैलं वसा मधु घृतमौषधानि च सर्वशः॥
en: A king, who is attacked by a hostile army, should collect wealth, and store oil and fat and honey, and clarified butter, and medicines of all sorts,

sa: अन्धकारीकृते लोके रजोभूते महीतले॥ योधाः सर्वे महाराज तावका: प्राद्रवन् भयात्।
en: When the earth was thus covered with dust and all the quarters were enshrouded with darkness your soldiers, O king, fled away on all sides in dismay.

sa: भूयः स भगवान् ध्यात्वा चिरं शूलवरायुधः। तस्य तस्य निकायस्य चकारैकैकमीश्वरम्॥
en: Thereafter the great god armed with a huge Shula, having again reflected for sometime, appointed a few among the gods as the rulers of their respective classes.

sa: आत्मापराधादापन्नस्तत् किं भीमं जिघांससि। तस्मात् संयच्छ कोपं त्वं स्वमनुस्मर दुष्कृतम्॥
en: That which has befallen you is due to your own fault. Why then do you seek to kill Bhima? Remembering your own folly govern your anger now.

sa: तस्माद् गच्छामहे सर्वे यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः। आख्यातुं सलिले सुप्तं दुर्योधनममर्षणम्॥
en: Let us then go all of us where king Yudhishthira is, for telling him that the vindictive Duryodhana is living hidden within the waters of this lake.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रात्मजं तस्मै भीमसेनाय धीमते। शयानं सलिले सर्वे कथयामो धनु ते॥
en: Let us also, all of us, inform that great bowman, the intelligent Bhimasena, that the son of Dhritarashtra has hidden himself within the waters of this lake.

sa: छायायामप्सु वायौ च सुखमुष्णेऽधिगच्छति॥ अग्नौ वाससि सूर्ये च सुखं शीतेऽधिगच्छति।
en: In summer, men seek comfort from the shade of trees, cool water, and cool breezes. In winter, they derive comfort from fire, warm clothing and the sun.

sa: दैवेनाभ्याहतो राजा कर्मकाले महाद्युते। न साधयति यत् कर्म न तत्राहुरतिक्रमम्॥
en: O you of great splendour, if a king, possessed by destiny, fails to accomplish an act in proper time, such failure would not be called a trespass.

sa: इत्येवमाज्ञाय विदेहराजो वाक्यं समग्रं परिपूर्णहेतुः। र्ययौ गृहं स्वं प्रति शान्तशोकः॥
en: Having heard these words pregnant with reason, the king of the Videhas of clear understanding became freed from grief, and taking Ashma's leave proceeded towards his house.

sa: पुनरेव तु वक्ष्यामि पाण्डवेय निबोध मे। धर्मराजापराधेन भयं नः पुनरागतम्॥
en: I tell you again, O son of Pandu, listen to ine! It is through the fault of king Yudhishthira alone that danger has once more befallen us.

sa: बलिषड्भागमुद्धृत्य बलिं समुपयोजयेत्। न रक्षति प्रजाः सम्यग् यः स पार्थिवतस्करः॥
en: Taking from his subjects a sixth part of their riches, he should protect them all. That king, who does not protect his subjects, is indeed, a thief.

sa: अकार्याणि तु वक्ष्यामि यानि तानि निबोध मे। लोकवेदविरुद्धानि तान्येकाग्रमनाः शृणु॥
en: I shall now mention other acts which men should not do, viz., acts that are forbidden by men and the Vedas. Listen to me with rapt attention.

sa: श्लोकश्चायं पुरा गीतो भार्गवेण महात्मना। आख्याते राजचरिते नृपति प्रति भारत॥
en: The following verse was recited in days of yore by Ushanas of Bhrigu's race, in the narrative called Ramacharita, on the subject, O Bharata, of royal duties.

sa: यद्येकस्तु न हन्तव्यो बहुभिर्धर्म एव तु। तदाभिमन्युं बहवो निजघ्नुस्त्वन्मते कथम्॥
en: If this be your duty, that one should not be killed by many, why is it then that Abhimanyu was killed by many, acting under your advice?

sa: संजय उवाच इत्युक्ते धर्मराजेन वासुदेवोऽब्रवीदिदम्। काममस्त्वेतदिति वै कृच्छ्राद् यदुकुलोद्वहः॥ इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन भीमप्रियहितैषिणा। अन्वमोदत तत् सर्वं यद् भीमेन कृतं युधि॥ भीमसेनोऽपि हत्वाऽऽजौ तव पुत्रममर्षणः। अभिवाद्याग्रतः स्थित्वा सम्प्रहृष्टः कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Sanjaya continued After Yudhishthira had said this, Vasudeva, said with difficulty-Let it be so! After Vasudeva had been addressed in those words by Yudhishthira, the former, who, always wished what was pleasant to, and beneficial for, Bhima, insooth, approved all those acts that Bhima had done in battle. Having struck down your son in battle, the wrathful Bhimasena, his heart overflowing with joy, stood with joined hands before Yudhishthira and saluted him duly.

sa: भीमसेनस्य तद् दुःखमतीव हदि वर्तते। इति संचिन्त्य वार्ष्णेय मयैतत् समुपेक्षितम्॥
en: On account of all those acts great grief exists in Bhimasena's heart! Thinking of all this, O hero of the Vrishnis's race, I looked on with indifference!

sa: क्षत्रियेषु हतेष्वाशु शून्ये च शिबिरे कृते॥ वधाय चात्मनोऽस्माभिः संयुगं रोचयिष्यति।
en: After all the Kshatriyas will have been killed and the (Kaurava) camp made empty, Duryodhana will then wish for a battle with us for his own destruction.

sa: तस्मै स विधिवत् कृत्स्नं ब्रह्मास्त्रं सनिवर्तनम्। प्रोवाचाखिलमव्यग्रं तपस्वी तत् तपस्विने॥
en: Ever practising ascetic penances, Rama cheerfully communicated, with due forms, to his disciple who practised penances everything about the Brahma weapon with the Mantras for withdrawing it.

sa: श्रियं च पुत्रपौत्रं च मनुष्या धर्मचारिणः। योगधर्मविदो धीराः स्वयमेव त्यजन्त्युत॥
en: Prosperity relinquishes the person that hates others. Pious and wise men conversant with the duties of Yoga renounce prosperity and sons and grandsons of their own accord.

sa: शक्रप्रियैषी यं विद्वान् प्रत्याचष्ट बृहस्पतिः॥ संवर्तो याजयामास यवीयान् स बृहस्पतेः।
en: To do Indra a good turn the learned Brihaspati refused to officiate at Marutta's sacrifice. Thereupon Samvarta, the younger brother of Brihaspati, complied with the king's request.

sa: समासाद्याथ वै द्रौणिं पाण्डुपुत्रा महारथाः। व्यजयंस्ते रणे राजन् विक्रम्य तदनन्तरम्॥
en: It was after this, O king, that the sons of Pandu, those great car-warriors, met the son of Drona, and displaying their prowess, defeated him, O king."

sa: शूरमानी न शूरस्त्वं मृषां वदसि भारत। शूरोऽहमिति दुर्बुद्धे सर्वलोकस्य शृण्वतः॥
en: Though always vaunting of your courage, you are however, not a hero. Falsely you describe yourself, O Bharata, before all men as a hero, O wicked wight.

sa: तत: सविस्मयश्चिन्तां जगामाथामितप्रभः॥ कथं भिक्षुरयं प्राप्तः समुद्रेः स्नात एव च।
en: Thereat the lord Asita, became filled with wonder and thought within himself-"How could the mendicant come to the ocean and perform his ablutions even before my arrival?'

sa: त्वं तु शुक्लाभिजातीयः परदोषेण कारितः। अनिच्छमानः कर्मेदं कृत्वा च परितप्यसे॥
en: You are born in a noble family. Urged by the sons of others, you have most reluctantly done this, and having done this you repent for it.

sa: प्रागेव तु धनादानमनुभाष्य ततः पुनः। संनिपत्य स्वविषये भयं राष्ट्र प्रदर्शयेत्॥
en: First of all, for making collection, the king should visit the principal centres of his kingdom one after another and try to fill his people with fear.

sa: प्रणष्टः कुरुवंशश्च पुनर्येन समुद्धृतः। स गतः कुरुभिः सार्धं महाबुद्धिः पराभवम्॥
en: Alas, he who had revived the extinct line of Kuru, that illustrious and highly intelligent person, has left the world with all the Kurus in his company.

sa: धर्मं सूक्ष्मतरं वाच्यं तत्र दुष्प्रतरं त्वया। धनंजय न मे बुद्धिमभिशङ्कितुमर्हसि।॥
en: You are, therefore, competent to speak of the niceties of those subjects, that are not understood by others. You should not, however, O Dhananjaya, doubt my intelligence.

sa: स्ति मैत्री स्थिरा नाम न च ध्रुवमसौहृदम्। अर्थयुक्त्यानुजायन्ते मित्राणि रिपवस्तथा॥
en: There is no condition that passes for ever by the name either of friendship or enemies. Both friends and enemies arise from considerations of interest and gain.

sa: काले धुरि च युक्तानां वहतां भारमाहितम्। सीदतामपि कौन्तेय न कीर्तिरवसीदति॥
en: The fame of men never suffers, even it they fail in bearing the burden which is placed on them and to which they are wedded for life.

sa: यथाऽऽस्तां सम्मतौ राज्ञां पृथिव्यां राजसत्तम॥ मान्धाता चाम्बरीषश्च तथा राजन् विराजसे।
en: You appear in splendour now, O monarch, even as those two foremost of kings, viz., Mandhatri and Ambarisha, respected by all the kings, did in former days.

sa: स चकार तदाऽऽलस्यं वरदानात् सुदुर्मतिः। न चैच्छच्चरितुं गन्तुं दुरात्मा कालमोहितः॥
en: Since the day of securing the boon, the foolish animal became idle. Indeed, stupefied by fate, the wretch did not from that day go out for grazing.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच तत्त्वज्ञो जनको राजा लोकेऽस्मिन्निति गीयते। सोऽप्यासीन्मोहसम्पन्नो मा मोहवशमन्वगाः॥
en: Arjuna said King Janaka was known as a truth-knowing person in the world. Even he, was bewildered in the ascertainment of duty. Do not yield to stupefaction.

sa: ध्वजं निपतितं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवं च व्यवस्थितम्॥ संक्रुद्धो मद्रराजोऽभूच्छरवर्षं मुमोच ह।
en: Seeing his standard fallen and observing the son of Pandu standing before him, the king of the Madras, worked up with range, shot a number of shafts.

sa: तत उत्थाय दाशार्हः शङ्खमादाय पूजितम्। अभ्यषिञ्चत् पतिं पृथ्व्याः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥ धृतराष्ट्रश्च राजर्षिः सर्वाः प्रकृतयस्तथा। अनुज्ञातोऽथ कृष्णेन भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवः॥ पाञ्चजन्याभिषिक्तश्च राजामृतमुखोऽभवत्। ततोऽनुवादयामासुः पणवानकदुन्दुभीन्॥
en: Then rising from his seat, Krishna took up the sanctified conch, poured the water it continued upon the head of king Yudhishthira the son of Kunti. The royal sage Dhritarashtra and all the subjects also did the same as requested by Krishna. Thus bathed with the sanctified water of the conch, the son of Pandu then, with his brothers, looked highly beautiful.

sa: यस्तु द्यूतजितां कृष्णां प्राहसत् पुरुषाधमः। तस्याद्य सूतपुत्रस्य भूमिः पिबति शोणितम्॥
en: The Earth is drinking today the blood of the charioteer's sun, the wretch of a man who had laughed at Draupadi won at the game of dice.

sa: न संशयमनारुह्य नरो भद्राणि पश्यति। संशयं पुनरारुह्य यदि जीवति पश्यति॥
en: No can derive benefit without incurring danger. If, again, he succeeds in preserving his life in the midst of danger's he is sure to acquire great benefits.

sa: स कदाचित् प्रसायैव तां ग्रीवां शतयोजनाम्। चचाराश्रान्तहृदयो वातश्चागात् ततो महान्॥
en: One day, while extending his long neck of a hundred Yojanas, the animal was engaged in picking his food without any trouble, there uprose a great storm.

sa: अर्थयुक्तिमिमां तत्र यथाभूतां निशामय। तव जीवितमिच्छामि त्वं ममेच्छसि जीवितम्॥ नौ।
en: Know this to be the proper time for such a compact between us. I wish that you should live, and you also wish that I should live.

sa: एतेनैव च वृत्तेन महीं प्राप सुरोत्तमः। अनेन चेन्द्रविषयं विजिगीषन्ति पार्थिवाः॥
en: It was by such conduct that Indra became the king of the world. It is by this conduct that earthly kings attain to the dignity of Indra.

sa: एतेनैतन्महद् वैरं प्रसक्तं पाण्डवैः सह। वधाय मम पुत्राणामात्मनः सगणस्य च॥
en: This fire of hostility with the Pandavas had been lighted by Shakuni, for the destruction of my children as also of himself and his followers ar relatives.

sa: शेतेऽसौ शरपूर्णाङ्गः शत्रुस्ते कुरुपुङ्गव। तं पश्य पुरुषव्याघ्र विभिन्नं बहुभिः शरैः॥
en: Wounded all over with arrows, your enemy, O foremost of Kurus, is lying prostrate on the naked Earth. Look at that best of men mangled with arrows.

sa: तस्मात् प्रज्ञामृतमिदं चिरान्मां प्रत्युपस्थितम्। तत् प्राप्य प्रार्थये स्थानमव्ययं शाश्वतं ध्रुवम्॥
en: Meditating on these circumstances, this nectar of wisdom has come to me. Having attained it, I desire to get a permanent, eternal, and ever-abiding place (for myself).

sa: तस्य मेऽप्यधिकं शस्त्रं सर्वोपकरणानि च॥ संसज्जन्तु रथे क्षिप्रं शास्त्रवद् रथयोजकाः
en: Let them that furnish car quickly supply my car according to the rules of science, with all kinds of weapons and implements more than what Shalya possesses.

sa: तद् राजन् जीवनमानस्त्वं प्रायश्चित्तं करिष्यसि। प्रायश्चित्तमकृत्वा तु प्रेत्य तप्तासि भारत॥
en: Therefore, O king, without laying down your life, perform those expiatory acts. If you do not perform them you may have to repent in the next world.”

sa: अज्ञायमाने हीनत्वे संधिं कुर्यात् परेण वै। लिप्सुर्वा कंचिदेवार्थं त्वरमाणो विचक्षणः॥
en: The wise king should quickly make peace with enemies even when he knows that he is not weak, if he can derive any advantage out of it.

sa: तद् राजन् जीवनमानस्त्वं प्रायश्चित्तं करिष्यसि। प्रायश्चित्तमकृत्वा तु प्रेत्य तप्तासि भारत॥
en: Therefore, O king, without laying down your life, perform those expiatory acts. If you do not perform them you may have to repent in the next world.”

sa: एवं गते महाराज राज्यं प्रति जनाधिप। हेतुमत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि तमिहैकमनाः शृणु॥
en: When such in the case, O king, I will point out, O king, the reasons in favour of your assuming sovereignty. Listen to me with rapt attention.

sa: इमामवस्थां सम्प्राप्तं दीनमार्तं श्रिया च्युतम्। यदन्यत् सुखमस्तीह तद् ब्रह्मन्ननुशाधि माम्॥
en: I am shorn of prosperity and have been reduced to a miserable and unhappy plight! Instruct me, O Brahmana, what happiness I may yet try to secure.

sa: ऋषीणामपि राजेन्द्र सत्यमेव परं धनम्। तथा राज्ञां परं सत्यान्नान्यद् विश्वासकारणम्॥
en: Even to the Rishis, O king, Truth, is the greatest wealth. Likewise for the kings, there is nothing that so much creates confidence in them as Truth.

sa: एवमेष क्षयोः वृत्तः कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः। घोरो विशसनो रौद्रो राजन् दुर्मन्त्रिते तव॥
en: Thus the armies of the Kurus and the Pandavas have been killed. Great and terrible has been that destruction, O king, brought on by your evil policy.

sa: अहमन्नं भवान् भोक्ता दुर्बलोऽहं भवान् बली॥ नावयोर्विद्यते संधिर्वियुक्ते विषमे बले।
en: I am your food. You are the eater. I am weak. You are strong. There cannot be any friendship between us when we are so unevenly placed.

sa: अद्य श्रेष्ठस्य जानीतां पाण्डवस्य पराक्रमम्। मद्रराजं हतं श्रुत्वा देवैरपि सुदुःसहम्॥
en: Hearing of the death of the ruler of the Madras who was incapable of defeat by the very celestials, that king will know the prowess of Yudhishthira.

sa: तेजो माहेश्वरं स्कनमग्नौ प्रपतितं पुरा। तत् सर्वभक्षो भगवान् नाशकद् दग्धुमक्षयम्॥
en: In days of yore the vital seed of Maheshvara, dropped into a blazing fire. The consumer of everything, the worshipful Agni, could not burn that indestructible seed.

sa: वयमेवात्र गर्वा हि यद् वयं मन्दचेतसम्। त्वां राजन्ननुगच्छामो ज्येष्ठोऽयमिति भारत॥
en: We have become butts of censure, O Bharata, because, O king, we follow you who are of weak understanding, in consequence of yourself being our eldest brother!

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अर्जुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा भीमसेनोऽत्यमर्षणः। धैर्यमास्थाय तेजस्वी ज्येष्ठं भ्रातरमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said After Arjuna had done the highly wrathful and energetic Bhimasena, collecting all his patience, said these words to his eldest brother:राजन् विदितधर्मोऽसि न तेऽस्त्यविदितं क्वचित्।

sa: लोकस्य व्यसनी नित्यं परिभूतो भवत्युत। उद्वेजयति लोकं च योऽतिद्वेषी महीपतिः॥
en: He that is attached to those practices is under the influence of every one. The king who does not love his subjects fills the latter with anxiety.

sa: वधेन च मनुष्याणां मार्गाणां दूषणेन च। अगाराणां विनाशैश्च परराष्ट्रं विनाशयेत्॥
en: By killing its inhabitants, by breaking its roads and otherwise injuring them, and by burning and pulling down its houses, a king should devastate an enemy's realm.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततोऽमृतसमैर्वाक्यै दयन् पुरुषर्षभम्। वैचित्रवीर्यं विदुरो यदुवाच निबोध तत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Listen, O Janamejaya, to the nectar like words that Vidura said to the son of Vichitravirya and by which be pleased that foremost of men.

sa: यच्च तेऽभ्यनुजानीयुः कर्म तात सुपूजिताः। धर्माधर्मविरुद्धं वा तत् कर्तव्यं युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Adored by you, whatever they will command you, be it consistent with righteousness, or be it inconsistent with it, you should carry it out unhesitatingly, O Yudhishthira.

sa: न ह्यहं कामये नित्यमतिक्रान्तेन रक्षणम्। वर्तमानेन वर्तेयं तत् क्षिप्रं संविधीयताम्॥
en: I do not desire that I should be protected by my present kings. Do you, O sage, quickly make such arrangements that I may remain (as before).

sa: तमहं नृपतिं दीनमब्रवं पुनरेव च। स्मर्तव्योऽस्मि महाराज दर्शयिष्यामि ते सुतम्॥
en: Seeing the king very cheerless, I said to him,-Think of me, O king, (in your distress), and I shall promise to come when thought of by you.

sa: श्रद्धावता च यष्टव्यमित्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः। मिथ्योपेतस्य यज्ञस्य किमु श्रद्धा करिष्यति॥
en: It occurs in the Vedas that a person should with devotion, celebrate a sacrifice. But what can devotion do when the sacrifice is sullied by false substitutes?

sa: यस्य शोणितवेगेन वेदिः स्यात् सम्परिप्लुता॥ केशमांसास्थिसम्पूर्णा स गच्छेत् परमां गतिम्।
en: That warrior, on the other hand, whose blood drenches the sacrificial altar already covered with hair and flesh and bones, forsooth, succeeds in acquiring a glorious end.

sa: द्रौणिरुवाच इममात्मानमद्याहं जातमाङ्गिरसे कुले। स्वग्नौ जुहोमि भगवन् प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मां बलिम्॥
en: Ashvatthaman said Born in Angira's family I am about to pour my soul, O god, as a lit ion on this fire. Accept, O lord, this victim.

sa: अधर्मयुक्तो विजयो ह्यध्रुवोऽस्व→ एव च। सादयत्येष राजानं महीं च भरतर्षभ॥
en: A victory sullied by unrighteousness is uncertain and never leads to heaven. Such a victory, O foremost of Bharata's race, weakens both the king and the Earth.

sa: गयं चामूर्तरयसं मृतं शुश्रुम संजय। यः स वर्षशतं राजा हुतशिष्टाशनोऽभवत्॥
en: We hear, O Stinjaya, that Gaya also, the son of Amurtharayas, met with death. For a hundred years, that king lived upon the residue of sacrificial food.

sa: गुह्यमेतत् तु देवानां कथयिष्यामि तेऽनघ। तन्निबोध महाबाहो यथा वृत्तमिदं पुरा॥
en: This, O sinless one, that I am about to tell you is unknown to the very celestials. Listen to me, O mighty-armed one, as it happened formerly.

sa: आश्रमस्थानि भूतानि यस्तु वेश्मनि भारत। आददीतेह भोज्येन तद् गार्हस्थ्यं युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Inviting to his home, O Bharata, persons who have adopted the Vanaprastha and other modes of life, and feasting them form the domestic duties of a king.

sa: तर्पयामास सोमेन देवान् वित्तैर्द्विजानपि। पितृन् स्वधाभिः कामैश्च स्त्रियः स पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: That foremost of men pleased the gods with Soma, the Brahmanas, with wealth, the Pitris with Svadha, and the women with the satisfaction of all their desires.

sa: मृषावादं परिहरेत् कुर्यात् प्रियमयाचितः। न कामान च संरम्भान्न द्वेषाद् धर्ममुत्सृजेत्॥
en: Falsehoods should be avoided. You should do good to others without being asked for the same. You should never abandon righteousness from lust or anger or malice.

sa: जगाम चास्तं सविता दिवाकरः। ग्रहश्च तिर्यग् ज्वलनार्कवर्णः सोमस्य पुत्रोऽभ्युदियाय तिर्यक्॥
en: The rivers were calın when Karna fell. The sun set with pale colour. Burning like fire or the sun, Soma's son Mercury moved askance through the sky

sa: सुमहान्तं ततः कालं प्रतीक्ष्यैनं पितामहः। स्रष्टारं सर्वभूतानां ससर्ज मनसा परम्॥
en: Having waited for Rudra for a very long time, the Grandfather by his willpower called into being another living being for the purpose of propagating his species.

sa: स च्छिनः पतितो भूमौ पार्थबाणैर्महाहवे। दारयन् पृथिवीन्द्राणं मनांसीव च भारत॥
en: Cut off with Partha's shaft in that great battle, that weapon dropped down on earth, riving the hearts, as it were, O Bharata, of the inimical kings.

sa: शक्यते विधिनां पापं यथोक्तेन व्यपोहितुम्। आस्तिके श्रद्दधाने च विधिरेष विधीयते॥
en: Forsooth, sin is capable of being washed away by following the ordinances. Those ordinances, however, have been laid down only for them who have faith in God.

sa: सोऽब्रवीत् पितरं दृष्ट्वा गिरिशं सुप्तमम्भसि। यदि मे नाग्रजोऽस्त्यन्यस्तत: स्रक्ष्याम्यहं प्रजाः॥
en: Seeing Girisha plunged into the water, this (second) being, said to his father,-If there be no other being born before me, then I shall multiply my self.

sa: श्रेयो नो भीमसेनस्य क्रुद्धस्याभिमुखे स्थितम्। सुखः सांग्रामिको मृत्युः क्षत्रधर्मेण युध्यताम्॥
en: It will be to our interest if we stay before the angry Bhimasena. Death in battle, while fighting in pursuance of the Kshatriya practices, leads to happiness.

sa: ते सदोषा हतास्माभी राज्यस्य परिपन्थिनः। तान् हत्वा भुड्क्ष्वधर्मेण युधिष्ठिर महीमिमाम्॥
en: Committing the same fault, those that stood as enemies of our kingdom have all been killed by us. Having killed then, O Yudhishthira, righteously govern this Earth!

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच भरद्वाजस्य विप्रर्षेः स्कन्नं रेतो महात्मनः॥ दृष्ट्वाऽप्सरसभायान्तीं घृताचीं पृथुलोचनाम्।
en: Vaishampayana said "The vital seed of the great Rishi Bharadvaja fell upon beholding the large eyed Apsara Ghritachi as the latter was passing by at one time.

sa: ध्वजं सप्तभिरुन्मथ्य यन्तारमवधीत् त्रिभिः। तस्य सूते हते तेऽश्वा रथमादाय विद्रुताः॥
en: He pierced his standard with sixteen and his charioteer with seven shafts. When Chekitana's charioteer was killed, the horses ran wildly dragging the car along with them.

sa: कस्मिन्निदं हते राजन् रथसिंहे बलं तवा एतामवस्थां सम्प्राप्तं तन्ममाचक्ष्व कौरव॥
en: O king, even these division headed by Karna and others are not staying on the field. In no previsions battle was the arıny thus broken and routed.

sa: अनीकं भीमसेनस्य पाण्डवावाशु गच्छताम्। जीमूत इव नद॑स्तु युध्यते स वृकोदरः॥
en: O sons of Pandu! Both of you should join immediately the army where Bhimasena is stood. Bhimasena is fighting there with challenge as loud as the cloud.

sa: वृद्धक्षत्रो वनं यातस्तपश्चोग्रं समास्थितः॥ सोऽयं तप्यति तेजस्वी तपो घोरं दुरासदम्।
en: Vridhakshatra, retired into the woods and devoted himself to ascetic austerities. Possessed of great energy, he is still engaged in the observance of the austerest of penances.

sa: ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिमित्राणामिमं श्रुत्वा पराभवम्॥ को मदन्यः पुमाँल्लोके न जह्यात् सूत जीवितम।
en: O Suta, having heard of this utter defeat of kinsmen, relatives and friends, what other person in this world except myself would not give up his life?

sa: शमकामः ससोदो दीर्घप्रेक्षी युधिष्ठिरः। अशक्त इति मत्वा तु मम पुत्रैर्निराकृतः॥
en: The foresighted Yudhishthira that son of Pritha, was ever desirous of peace. But my sons turned him out, taking him to be incapable (of launching on war).

sa: ऋषेः प्रसादात् कृष्णस्य सत्यवत्याः सुतस्य च। विधूमामिह संयान्तीमुल्कां प्रज्वलितामिव॥ अपश्याम दिवं स्तब्वा गच्छन्तं तं महाद्युतिम्। हते द्रोणे निरुत्साहान् कुरून् पाण्डवसृञ्जयाः॥
en: Through the grace of the sage KrishnaDvaipayana, the son of Satyavati. I then beheld that effulgent one proceeding, after his ascension to the sky, like a blazing flame-beam free from even a curl of smoke flying through the welkin. Upon the slaughter of Drona, the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Srinjayas, all became depressed.

sa: हताश्वे तु रथे तिष्ठञ्शतानीको महारथः। गदां चिक्षेप संक्रुद्धस्तव पुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: O sire, that mighty car-warrior, Shatanika, waiting in a car, that was deprived of its horses and becoming very wrathful, had thrown a mace upon your son.

sa: यो ह्यनाथ इवाक्रम्य पार्षतेन हतस्तथा॥ कर्मणा सुनृशंसेन तस्य नाथो व्यवस्थितः।
en: He, who has been slain like one helpless by the son of Prisata, by a cruel and deceitful means, yonder stands the protector of that one. name

sa: योगयुक्तं महात्मानं गच्छन्तं परमां गतिम्। अहं धनंजयः पार्थो कृपः शारद्वतस्तथा॥
en: The illustrious Drona, lost in yoga and meditation, ascend to the highest regions of blessedness. These five were, myself, Pritha's son Dhananjaya, Ashvatthaman, the son of Drona.

sa: मुखं किंचित् समुन्नाम्य विष्टभ्य उरमग्रतः। निमीलिताक्षः सत्त्वस्थो निक्षिप्य हृदि धारणाम्॥
en: Slightly bending down his face and throwing his breast forward and shutting his eyes and reposing on the quality of goodness and directing his mind on meditation.

sa: तस्मै कर्णः शतं राजनिघूणां गार्धवाससाम्। अमर्षी बलवान् क्रुद्धः प्रेषयामास भारत॥
en: Then, O king, the revengeful and enraged and mighty Karna, sped at Bhima a group of hundred arrows furnished with wings of the feathers of the vultures.

sa: संग्रामे क्रियतां यत्नो ब्रवीम्येष पुनः पुनः। पाण्डवेभ्य: शिवं वोऽस्तु शस्रमभ्युत्सृजाम्यहम्॥
en: Exert your best in the battle: this I tell you repeatedly; may no injury befall you from the Pandavas; I am going to lay aside my weapons.

sa: अहं तु निहतामात्यो हतपुत्रश्च संजय॥ द्यूततः कृच्छ्रमापन्नो लूनपक्ष इव द्विजः।
en: O Sanjaya, I, who deprived of counsellor and sons, have too, obtained great misery consequent upon the game at dice, like a bird shorn of its wings.

sa: सदेवासुरगन्धर्वास्त्री लोकान् सतराचरांन्॥ त्वं हि जेतुं रणे शक्तस्तथैव विदितं मम।
en: I know well that you are capable to conquer in battle all the three worlds together with its mobile and immobile creations and the gods and Gandharvas.

sa: यः सूतपुत्रः प्रहसन् दुरात्मा पुराब्रवीनिर्जिता सौबलेन। मपीह कचित् स हतस्त्वयाद्य॥
en: That unrighteous son of Suta who had, grinning all the while, ordered Dusvashanta to drag out Jagyasena's daughter won by Subala's son (as a stake) at dice;

sa: शृणुष्वैतच वाक्यं मे जयद्रथवधं प्रति॥ वृद्धक्षत्रः सैन्धवस्य पिता जगति विश्रुतः।
en: Listen however to the words that I am going to speak about the slaughter of Jayadratha. The father of Jayadratha is Vridhakshatra known all over the world.

sa: प्रतोदं गृह्य सोऽन्यत्तु रश्मीनपि यथा पुरा। वाहयामास तानश्वान् सत्यसेनरथं प्रति॥
en: Then that highly famous one (Krishna) immediately taken up the whip as well as the reins, led those steeds (i.e. the car) towards the car of Satyasena.

sa: स तदा विविधान् मार्गान् प्रवरांश्चैकविंशतिम्। दर्शयामास कौरव्य पार्षतो विचरन् रणे॥
en: He then coursed in various tracks. Indeed, o foremost of the descendants of Kuru, Prisata's son carcering in that battle, displayed the well-known twenty-one kinds of evolution's.

sa: हस्तिहस्तान् हयग्रीवा बाहूनापि च सायुधान्। क्षुरप्रैः शातयामास तावकानां स माधवः॥
en: That scion of Madhu's race then severed with his razor-edged arrows, the trunks of elephants, the necks of horses and the arms of warriors decked with brace-lets.

sa: मुनिर्भूत्वाथवा भीम फलान्यादत्ख दुर्मते। वनाय व्रज कौन्तेय न त्वं युद्धविशारदः॥
en: Becoming a hermit, O Bhima, do you began eating fruits, O wicked-minded wretch. O son of Kunti, betake to the forest, for you are incapable of fighting.

sa: स्वयं वैरं महत् कृत्वा वार्यमाणः सुहृद्गणैः॥ प्रधने हतभूयिष्ठैः किंस्विद् दुर्योधनऽब्रवीत्।
en: Although having been forbidden by the friends, yet himself having created this fierce hostility, what did Duryodhana say, after beholding the slaughter of innumerable soldiers in battle?

sa: तौ रथौ सम्प्रसक्तौ तु दृष्ट्वा भारत पार्थिवाः। सिंहनादरवांश्चक्रुः साधुवादाश्च पुष्कलान्॥
en: O Bharata, all the kings began to give vent to lion-like roars (with excitement) seeing those two car warriors engaged with each other and praised them greatly.

sa: द्रोणं विव्याध सप्तत्या स्वर्णपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः। सारथिं चास्य बाणेन भृशं मर्मस्वताडयत्॥
en: He then pierced Drona with seventy shafts whetted on stone and furnished with golden wings; he pierced the latter's charioteer in his vital parts with (fierce) darts.

sa: तमापतन्तं वेगेन रभसं पाण्डवर्षभम्। कर्णः प्रत्युद्ययौ युद्धे मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥
en: Then as that foremost of the Pandavas was rushing with fury at him, Karna, excited with wrath, rushed at him like an infuriate elephant rushing at another.

sa: उद्यम्य त भुजानन्ये निक्षिप्य च महीतले॥ पदा चोरः समाक्रम्य स्फुरतोऽपाहरच्छिरः।
en: Some other combatants, having stretched their arms, hurled down their antagonists upon the ground, placed their feet upon their breasts and with great pleasure severed their heads.

sa: ततस्तु दुर्योधनभोजसौबलाः कृपेण शारद्वतसूनुना सह॥ महारथाः पञ्च धनंजयाच्युतौ शरैः शरीरार्तिकरैरताडयन्।
en: Then the five great car warriors viz. Duryodhana, the king of Bhojas, Subala's son Kripa and the son of Sharadvata attacked Dhananjaya and Keshava with deadly arrows.

sa: दृष्ट्वा च द्वैरथं ताभ्यां तत्र योधा सहस्रशः। चक्रर्बाहुस्वनांश्चैव तथा चैलावधूननम्॥
en: Thousands of fighters, seeing them thus engaged in duel fight, began to sound their arm-pits with the palm of their hands and shook their garments (in excitement).

sa: वासुदेवं च दशभिः प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे। प्रतोदं चास्य भल्लेन छित्त्वा भूमावपातयत्॥
en: He also pierced the son of Vasudeva with ten arrows between his breasts. The cutting off the whip of the latter, he felled it on the ground.

sa: ये तदास्मान् प्रनृत्यन्ति पुनगौरिति गौरिति॥ तान् वयं प्रतिनृत्यामः पुनर्गौरिति गौरिति।
en: And also said-"O you who were very glad and danced at our misery and called us beasts, we now fling back the words to your very teeth.

sa: दास्यामि ते तदास्त्राणि यदा पूतो भविष्यसि। अपात्रमसमर्थं च दहन्त्यस्त्राणि भार्गव॥
en: I will give you all these weapons, when you will become pure. For, O son of Bhrigu, these weapons burn that person, who is incompetent and incapable.

sa: पतिमन्यं परीप्सख न सन्ति पतयस्तव। पतिता नरके पार्थाः सर्वे षण्ढतिलोपमाः॥
en: To this effect="Take you another husband, for, all your husbands are dead; the sons of Pritha have merged into hell and are like sesamum seed without kernel."

sa: तं निहत्य रणे हृष्टो बृहत्क्षत्रो महारथः। सहसाभ्यपतत् सैन्यं तावकं पार्थकारणात्॥
en: Thus having slain his adversary, the mighty car-warrior Brihatkshatra became filled with delight; and he rushed quickly upon your troops, desirous of doing good to the Parthas.

sa: अद्य पश्यत मे वीर्यं बाह्वोः पीनांसयोर्युधि। ज्वलमानस्य दीप्तस्य द्रौणेरस्त्रस्य वारणे॥
en: Today you shall behold the strength of my arms and my expanded chest, when I shall exert in resisting the effulgent and burning weapon of Drona's son.

sa: तथा सर्वा दिशो राजन् सर्वाश्च रथिनो रणे॥ कदम्बीकृत्य कौन्तेयो जयद्रथमुपाद्रवत्।
en: Thereafter, O king, covering all the points of the compass with his arrows and afflicting all the car-warriors in battle, the son of Kunti dashed towards Jayadratha.

sa: दृष्ट्वा व्यूढां तव चमूं सूतपुत्रेण संयुगे। निहतान् पाण्डवान् मेनेधार्तराष्ट्रः सबान्धवः॥
en: Having witnessed your army arranged in battle by the son of Suta, the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana), with all his kinsmen, considered the Pandavas to be slain.

sa: स भवान् धर्मभीरुत्वाद् ध्रुवमैष्यन्महत्तमः। नरकं घोररूपं च भ्रातुर्येष्ठस्य वै वधात्॥
en: For moral scruples you would surely have taken out the life of your eldest and would have thus committed a heinous sin and fallen into eternal perdition.

sa: व्यसृजन्त शरौघांस्ते पाण्डवं प्रति पार्थिवाः। न चाव्यथत धर्मात्मा वासविः परवीरहा॥
en: Showers of arrows were poured upon that son of Pandu by the hostile kings; but that slayer of foes, the illustrious son of Vasava felt no pain.

sa: भीमं भीमायुधं क्रुद्धं साक्षात् कालमिव स्थितम्। वडवामुखमध्यस्थो मुच्येतापि हि मानवः॥
en: Bhima, inflamed with rage and armed with dreadful weapons and standing in battle like Death himself? It is possible for a man to escape from Varava fire.

sa: दैवादिष्टेऽन्यथाभावो नमन्ये विद्यते क्वचित्। यतो नो युध्यमानानां परं शक्त्या सुयोधन॥
en: My belief is that what is ordained by fate undergoes no alteration, when, O Suyodhana, in spite of our fighting to the very best of our power.

sa: प्रविष्टो भारती भित्त्वा तव पाण्डव पृष्ठतः। योधितश्च महावीर्यैः सर्वैर्भारत भारतैः॥
en: O son of Pandu, he has followed you having penetrated into the Bharata host. O Bharata, he has fought with many mighty warriors of the Bharata host.

sa: ऋषभं दुन्दुभिग्रीवं तीक्ष्णशृङ्गं प्रहारिणम्। वत्स आह्वयसे युद्धे कर्ण पार्थं धनंजयम्॥
en: O Karna, your challenge of Dhananjaya is like that of a calf against a fearful bull of sharpened horns and with a neck thick as a drum.

sa: अनादृत्य बलं बाह्वोर्भीमसेनस्य माधव। चित्रास्रतां च पार्थस्य विक्रमन्ति स्म कौरवः॥
en: Oscion of Madhu's race, the Kouravas are striving hard (for victory) setting at naught the might of Bhima's arm and the vast mastery of weapons of Arjuna.

sa: बहवः पक्षिणो राजन् पुन्नामानः शुभाः शिवाः॥१२ त्वरयन्तोऽर्जुनं युद्धे हृष्टरूपा ववाशिरे।
en: O king, a fight of birds, of beauty and good omen, called Pung, began to cackle merrily as if to urge Arjuna to hasten to the battle.

sa: सर्वाभिशङ्की मानी च ततोऽस्मानभिशङ्कसे॥ मन्ये त्वं कुत्सितो राजन् पापात्मा पापपुरुषः।
en: Self-conceited and suspicious of everybody, It is for this reason that you suspect ourselves too. O king, I deem you are a mean, wickedsouled and sinful person.

sa: परिश्रान्तं गतं भूतौ कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्। तवान्तेवासिनं वीरं पालयार्जुन सात्यकिम्॥
en: Having achieved many difficult feats he now laid low on the field in consequence of his great exhaustion. O Arjuna protect the heroic Satyaki, your (renowned) pupil.

sa: न वशं यज्ञशीलस्य गच्छेदेष वरोऽर्जुन। त्वत्कृते पुरुषव्याघ्र तदाशु क्रियतां विभो॥
en: O foremost of men, O Arjuna, do you soon take that measure by which Satyaki many not succumb to Bhurisravas the performer of numerous sacrifices, O lord.”

sa: भारद्वाजं जिघांसन्तौ सव्यसाचिवृकोदरौ। समार्च्छन् मामका युद्धे कथं संजय शंस मे॥
en: Describe to me, O Sanjaya, how my combatants in that battle covered with their arrows Dhananjaya and Vrikodara who were desirous of slaying the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: त्वां हि लोकास्त्रयः पार्थ ससुरासुरमानुषाः। नोत्सहन्ते रणे जेतुं किमुतैकः सुयोधनः॥
en: O Partha, the three worlds and the celestials, the Asuras and the men, cannot bear you in battle, what to speak of this singlehanded Suyodhana? of your

sa: प्रववुश्च शिवा वाताः प्रशान्ता मृगपक्षिणः। वाहनानि च हृष्टानि प्रशान्तेऽस्त्रे सुदुर्जये॥
en: Auspicious winds began to blow and animals and birds became quiet. The steeds and elephants as well as the warriors themselves became cheerful, O ruler of men.

sa: यथा तयोर्युद्धमभूद् यश्चासीद् विजयी तयोः। तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन कुशलो ह्यसि संजय॥
en: As you are conversant with these topies, O Sanjaya, tell me truly in detail how the battle between these two heroes, was fought and who obtained victory.

sa: ततो द्वैरथमानीय फाल्गुनं शक्रदत्तया। जघान न वृषः कस्मात् तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Tell me, O Sanjaya, why then Vrisha, summoning Arjuna to a single combat, did not slay the latter by means of the Sakti given him by Indra.

sa: निहत्य पितरं तेऽद्य ततस्त्वामपि संयुगे॥ नेष्यामि प्रेतलोकाय ह्येतन्मे मनसि स्थितम्।
en: I will (first) slay your father and then send yourself too, in battle, to the abode of the departed spirits, I chariot this (thought) in my mind.

sa: ताभ्यां द्यूतं समासक्तं विजयायेतराय च। अस्माकं पाण्डवानां च स्थितानां रणमूर्धनि॥
en: To decide the fate of the war they began that duel fight and our men and the Pandavas stood in front of the field see that fight.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवा राजंस्तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम्। कर्णस्य प्रमुखे क्रुद्धा निजध्नुस्ते महारथाः॥
en: O king, the mighty car-warriors, namely the Pandavas, had most wrathfully smitten the soldiers of your son in the same way in the very presence of Karna.

sa: एको हि समरे कर्म कृतवान् सत्यविक्रमः। शक्रतुल्यबलो युद्धे महेन्द्रो दानवेष्विव॥
en: Of indomitable prowess and possessed of strength equal to that of Indra himself, singlehanded he achieved feats amidst my troops like Indra achieving feats amidst the Danavas.

sa: सात्यकिस्तु ततो द्रोणं नवभिनतपर्वभिः। आजघान भृशं क्रुद्धो ध्वजं च निशितैःशरैः॥
en: Then excited to the highest pitch of fury, Satyaki struck Drona in battle with mine shafts of depressed knots. He also struck with sharp shafts, the standard.

sa: तावेनं भ्रातरौ वीरौ जघ्नतुर्हदये भृशम्। विषाणाभ्यां यथा नागौ प्रतिनागं महावने॥
en: Those two heroic brothers deeply pierced this warrior (Satyaki) in the chest, even as two elephant strike another hostile elephant with their tusks in a dense forest.

sa: छादयित्वा रणे द्रोणो रथस्थं रथिनां वरम्। जारासंधि जघानाशु मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: Then Drona completely covering that foremost of car-warrior name. Jarasadha's son riding on a golden chariot, quickly slew him, before the very eyes of all the warriors.

sa: अवश्यं तु मया कार्यमात्मनः शोकनाशनम्। तस्माद् भीमं नियोक्ष्यामि सात्वतस्य पदानुगम्॥
en: However, it is my duty to make myself altogether unaxious on their account. Therefore should I engage Bhima to follow in the track of the Satvata hero.

sa: ते वध्यमाना द्रोणेन शक्रेणेव महासुराः। समकम्पन्त पञ्चाला गावः शीतार्दिता इव॥
en: Then like mighty Asuras slain by Takra, they were being slaughtered by Drona. The Panchalas then began to tremble like kine afflicted with the chill of winter,

sa: ततस्तु सात्यकी राजन् सोमदत्तस्य संयुगे। धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन हस्तावापं च पञ्चभिः॥
en: Then, in the engagement, o king, Satyaki cut-off the bow of Somadatta with one broadheaded arrows and with another five the leathern case that sheathed his fingers.

sa: स यूपः काञ्चनो राजन् सौमदत्तेर्विगजते॥ राजसूये मखश्रेष्ठे यथा यूपः समुच्छ्रितः।
en: o king, that golden sacrificial stake decorating the banner of Somadatta's son, looked effulgent. Like the huge stake erected in that foremost of sacrifices, called the Rajasuya.

sa: पूरितो वासुदेवेन संरब्धेन यशखिना। नूनमद्य हतः शेते तव भ्राता धनंजयः॥
en: Filled with the breath of the illustrious and highly courageous son of Vasudeva, I infer that your brother Dhananjaya today is slain on the field of battle.

sa: ततोऽन्यं रथमास्थाय विधिवत्कल्पितं पुनः। केकयानां महत् सैन्यं व्यधमत् सात्यकिः शरैः॥
en: Thereupon, again, having ascended another car, that furnished with its its due equipment's, Satyaki began to destroy the immense army of the Kaikeyas with his was arrows.

sa: यथा शल्य विजानीषे एवमेतदसंशयम्। अभिप्रायस्तु मे कश्चित् तं निबोध जनेश्वर॥
en: O Shalya, this what you utter is doubtlessly true. In this, I have some object in sight. Be you, therefore, O lord of men, acquainted with this,

sa: दिष्ट्या पश्यामि संग्रामे तीर्णभारौ महारथौ। दिष्ट्या विनिहतः पाप: सैन्धवः पुरुषाधमः॥
en: (And) it is by good fortune that our enemies are downed in a sea of grief. In the three worlds there is nothing which they cannot perform.

sa: तमब्रवीत् ततो राजा प्रीयमाणः पुनः पुनः। द्रोणकर्णादिभिः सार्धं पर्याप्तोऽहं द्विषद्वधे॥
en: As also with their flesh. O foremost of kings, it behoves you to accord me your permission.” Thereupon king Duryodhana, highly gratified, repeatedly told these words to

sa: पुनर्विव्याध सप्तत्या ननाद च महाबलः। तस्य नादेन महता कम्पितेयं वसुंधरु॥
en: Once more pierced him with seventy arrows; and that highly powerful one sent up a loud roar. In consequence of that roar of his, the earth trembled.

sa: अद्य पश्यन्तु संग्रामे धनंजयमर्षणम्॥ युध्यन्तं कौरवान् संख्ये घातयन्तं च सूतजम्।
en: Let them all witness today the scene of the furious Dhananjaya, encountering all the Kaurava forces in the field, give a death-blow unto the son of Suta.

sa: तावेतौ पुरुषव्याधौ समेतो स्यन्दने स्थितौ॥ मामेकमभिसंयातौ सुजातं पश्य शल्य मे।
en: Those two foremost of men, seated on the same car, will encounter me single in battle, you will, O Shalya, witness today the nobility of my birth.

sa: अभ्यद्रवन्त वेगेन क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभम्। नरसिंहं रथोदारा: सिंह मत्ता इव द्विपाः॥
en: Then those Kshatriyas, illustrious carwarriors all, rushed with impetuously upon that foremost of Kshatriyas and that best of men, Arjuna, like infuriate elephant rushing upon a lion.

sa: ततः प्रायाद् रथेनाशु केशवस्तव वाहिनीम्। कर्णं प्रति महेष्वासं द्वैरथे सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Thus asked Keshava led the chariot through your army towards the great archer, Karna, with a view to bring about a dual fight between him and Savyasachin.

sa: संजय उवाच तदास्थितमवज्ञाय प्रत्यमित्रबलं महत्। अव्यूहतार्जुनो व्यूहं पुत्रस्य तव दुर्नये॥
en: Sanjaya said Disregarding the huge hostile array arranged in that way Arjuna rayed his force in proper form on account of the evil policy of your son.

sa: मध्ये राजसहस्राणां प्रेक्षकाणां समन्ततः। कृपया च पुनस्तेन स जीवेति विसर्जितः॥
en: In the midst of thousands of kings who were witnessing the combat, from all sides. Then out of mercy; the latter abandoned the former saying go, live.'

sa: पार्थं सिषिचतुर्बाणैर्गिरिं प्रेधाविवाम्बुभिः। तौ तु विद्ध्वा महाराज पाण्डवो निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Began to shower arrows on Pritha's son, like two risen clouds showering rain on the mountain-breast. Thereafter, . mighty monarch, Pandu's son piercing them both with shafts.

sa: नाशकत् तान्यभेद्यानि यदा भेत्तुः पुरंदरः॥ पुराणि वरदत्तानि धात्रा तेन नराधिप। तदा भीतः सुरपतिर्मुक्त्वा तानि पुराण्यथ॥ तैरेव विबुधैः सार्ध पितामहमरिदम्। जगामाथ तदाख्यातुं विप्रकारं सुरेतरैः॥
en: When, O foremost of monarchs, Purandara became incapable to pierce cities, which had been made impenetrable by that creator and which also had received the boons, Then, O subduer of enemies, the terror struck lord of the gods abandoning these cities and celestials, went to the Grandsire with a view to relate to him the great insults wrought out by the Asuras.

sa: ततो धनंजयो द्रष्टुं राजानं बाणपीडितम्। रथेन प्रययौ क्षिप्रं संग्रामात् केशवाज्ञया॥
en: see Himself too being desirous of seeing the king thus wounded with arrows, Dhananjaya, at the bidding of Keshava, left the battle and went on his car.

sa: कथमन्ये करिष्यन्ति पुत्रेभ्यः पुत्रिणः स्पृहाम्। कामात् क्रोधादविज्ञानाद्धर्षाद् बाल्येन वा पुनः॥
en: Why then should sonless men wish to obtain sons (who can help them in no way)? Moved by lust or wrath or ignorance or hatred or levity.

sa: तथार्धचन्द्रेण शिरस्तस्य चिच्छेद पाण्डवः। स पपात हतो म्लेच्छस्तेनैव सह दन्तिना॥
en: So again, the son of Pandu severed the head (of his antagonist) with a crescent shaped arrow. That Mlechchha, being thus cut-off, fell down with his elephant.

sa: तं तु ते प्रतिगर्जन्तः प्रत्युद्यातास्त्वमर्षिताः। यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं यथासत्त्वं च संयुगे॥
en: We two, on our part, roaring in return and filled with wrath, rushed against them, in battle, to the full measure of our prowess, enthusiasm and courage.

sa: अन्धकारं तमो घोरं प्रविशन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः। तत्र धर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि येन दुर्गाणि संतरेत्॥
en: They have to enter into a thick darkness. I shall now tell you of those duties by discharging which one may succeed in getting Over such disasters.

sa: स गर्भो दिव्यसंस्थानो दीप्तिमान् पावकप्रभः। दिव्यं शरवणं प्राप्य ववृधे प्रियदर्शनः॥
en: Indeed, the child, possessed of a beautiful form, shone like the god of Fire. Of beautiful features, he began to grow in a charming forest of reeds.

sa: स एष क्षत्रधर्मेण अयुध्यत रणाजिरे॥ धनञ्जयेन निहतो नैष देवि शिखण्डिना।
en: According to Kshatriya duties, he was killed by Dhananjaya on the field of battle while engaged in battle. He has not been killed, O goddess, by Shikhandin.

sa: अतोऽन्यथा वर्तमानाः सर्वे नार्हन्ति सत्क्रियाम्। तस्मान्नित्यं परीक्षेत पुरुषान् प्रणिधाय वै॥
en: Those persons who do not possess such qualifications cannot be considered as worthy of gifts or hospitality. Hence, one should with deliberation examine persons who one meets.

sa: तमादाय नरव्याघ्र सम्प्राप्तास्मि तवान्तिकम्॥ शमार्थं सर्वयोधानां शृणु चेदं वचो मम।
en: Taking him with me, O king, I have come to you desirous of the safety of all the warriors! Do you listen to these words of mine.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा व्यासो धर्मात्मजं नृपम्॥ यथाकालं यथायोगं सज्जाः स्म तव दीक्षणे।
en: Then the highly energetic Vyasa said to the royal son of Dharma, “As regards ourselves, we are all prepared to initiate you in view of the sacrifice.

sa: अभिजाने च तदहं यदर्थं मामुपागतः। अचिरात् तु गमिष्यामि तेनाहं त्वामचूचुदम्॥
en: I know that object for which you have sought me. I shall soon depart from this world. Hence it is that I have given you this hint.

sa: आजगाम ततो व्यासो ज्ञात्वा दिव्येन चक्षुषा। समागम्याब्रवीद् धीमान् पृथां पृथुललोचनाम्॥ उत्तरां च महातेजाः शोकः संत्यज्यतामयम्। भविष्यति महातेजाः पुत्रस्तव यशस्विनि॥ प्रभावाद् वासुदेवस्य मम व्याहरणादपि। पाण्डवानामयं चान्ते पालयिष्यति मेदिनीम्॥
en: Then Vyasa, ascertaining the state of things by his spiritual vision, arrived there. The highly intelligent Rishi, gifted with great energy, arrived (at the palace), addressed Pritha of large eyes, as also Uttara herself, saying, Let this grief be given up! O famous lady, a son gifted with great energy will be born to you, through the power of Vasudeva and at my word. That son will rule the Earth after the Pandavas.

sa: अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे पृथिवी दक्षिणा स्मृता॥ अर्जुनेन जिता चेयमृत्विग्भ्यः प्रापिता मया।
en: The Dakshina ordained in the scriptures for the great Horse-Sacrifice is the Earth, Hence, I have given away to the sacrificial priests the Earth conquered by Arjuna.

sa: ततः स निहतो राजा धार्तराष्ट्रो महारणे। भीमसेनेन विक्रम्य पश्यतां पृथिवीक्षिताम्॥
en: Then, in the great battle that took place, the royal son of Dhritarashtra was killed by Bhimasena, displayed his great prowess, in the presence of many kings.

sa: सिंहव्याघ्रप्रयुक्तेन विमानेन स गच्छति। सप्ततिं व सहस्राणि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते॥
en: Such a man rides a chariot drawn by lions and tigers. He lives in Heaven for seventy thousand years in the enjoyment of every sort of happiness.

sa: हिरण्यदण्ड्या वध्याश्च कर्तव्या देशकालतः॥ प्रातरेव हि पश्येथा ये कुर्युर्व्ययकर्म ते।
en: In the morning you should see those who are employed in making your disbursements. After that you should look to your toilet and then to your food.

sa: स गत्वा तपसः पारं दीप्तस्य वसुधाधिपः। पुरंदरस्य संस्थानं प्रतिपेदे महाद्युतिः॥
en: Reaching the other end of blazing penances, that king, gifted with great splendour, attained to the region of Purandara where he continued to live in his company.

sa: न पृच्छेद् गोत्रचरणं स्वाध्यायं देशमेव च। भिक्षितो ब्राह्मणेनेह दद्यादन्नं प्रयाचितः॥
en: Solicited by a Brahmana, one should not enquire about his family or conduct or Vedic learning. Asked for food, one should give food to him who asks.

sa: एवमेव गवामुक्तं प्रदानं ते नृगेण ह। ऋषिणा नाचिकेतेन पूर्वमेव निदर्शितम्॥
en: You have described to me the gifts of kine formerly made by king Nriga. The Rishi Nachiketa, in ancient times, had described the merits of this act.

sa: व्यायाममतिमात्रं च व्यवायं चोपसेवते। सततं कर्मलाभाद् वा प्राप्तं वेगं विधारयेत्॥
en: He indulges in physical exercise and sexual pleasure in excess, or through avidity for work, suppresses the urgings of his corporeal organism even when they become pronounced.

sa: स तैः सम्पूजितो राजा शिवेनावेक्षितस्तथा॥ प्राञ्जलिः पूजयामास तं जनं भरतर्षभ।
en: Thus honoured by them and looked upon with auspicious looks, the old king, O chief of Bharata's race, joined his hands and honoured them all in returi.

sa: संरक्ष्यमाणं तुरगं यौधिष्ठिरमुपागतम्। यज्ञियं विषयान्ते मां नायौत्सी: किं नु पुत्रक॥
en: I have come here as the protector of Yudhishthira's sacrificial horse. Why, O son, will you not fight me, seeing that I have come within your territories?

sa: वानराः पक्षिणश्चैव ये मनुष्यानुसारिणः॥ सर्वे मन्त्रगृहे वा ये चापि जडपङ्गवः।
en: Apes and birds and other animals which can imitatc human beings should all be excluded from the council chamber, as also idiots and lame and palsied individuals.

sa: एतत् ते देवदेवस्य माहात्म्यं कथितं प्रभो। कपर्दिनो गिरीशस्य महाबाहो जनार्दन॥
en: O Mighty-armed Janardana, I have thus, O Powerful One, recited to You the glory of that God of gods, viz., Him that is called Kapardin or Girisha.

sa: इन्द्रकन्याभिरूढं च विमानं लभते नरः। सागरस्य च पर्यन्ते वासवं लोकमावसेत्॥
en: He lives in the region, of Indra for millions and millions of years, and enjoys great happiness by witnessing the sports of the king of the gods.

sa: प्रजाः पालयते यो हि धर्मेण मनुजाधिपः। तस्य धर्मार्जिता लोकाः प्रजापालनसंचिताः॥
en: The king who rules and protects his subjects piously, acquires, by virtue of the protection he offers to others, many regions of happiness in the next world.

sa: य एवममृतं नित्यमग्राह्यं शश्वदक्षरम्। वश्यात्मानमसंश्लिष्टं यो वेद न मृतो भवेत्॥
en: He dies not who understands Him' who is immortal, immutable, incomprehensible, men are eternal and indestructible-Him who is the restrained Soul and who is above all attachments.

sa: कृतघ्नोऽयं नृशंसोऽयं यथास्य जनकस्तथा। यः पाण्डवीं श्रियं त्यक्त्वा गतोऽद्य यमसादनम्॥२२
en: This child is very ungrateful and very heartless, like his father, for, sce, disregarding the prosperity and affluence of the Pandavas, he has gone to Yama's house.

sa: कृषिभागी भवेच्छ्राद्धं कुर्वाण: सप्तमी नृप। अष्टम्यां तु प्रकुर्वाणो वाणिज्ये लाभमाप्नुयात्॥
en: By performing it on the seventh day, O king, one wins great fame. By performing it on the eighth day one, secures great profits in commercial pursuits.

sa: आशीर्युक्तानि सर्वाणि हिंसायुक्तानि यानि च। लोकसंग्रहधर्मं च नैव कुर्यान्न कारयेत्॥
en: One should not perform, nor cause to perform, any such deed as involves expectation of fruit or destruction of life or the hoarding of riches or articles.

sa: उवाच देवताः सर्वाः पितूंश्चैव महाद्युतिः। श्रुतं हि चित्रगुप्तस्य धर्मगुह्यं महात्मनः॥
en: Gifted with great splendour, he addressed all the celestials and the departed Manes, saying, Ye have heard the mysteries about duty, as explained by the great Chitragupta.

sa: स राजन् मानसं दुःखमपनीय युधिष्ठिरात्॥ कुरु कार्याणि धाणि नमस्ते पुरुषर्षभ।
en: Do you, therefore, O king, reinoving all anxiety of heat on account of Yudhishthira, set yourself to the accomplishment of all meritorious deeds, O foremost of men.

sa: श्रीरुवाच अवज्ञाता भविष्यामि सर्वलोकस्य मानदाः। प्रत्याख्यानेन युष्माकं प्रसादः क्रियतां मम॥
en: Shree said You givers of honours, renounced by you thus, I shall certainly be an object of disregard with all the world? Do you show me grace.

sa: न हिरण्यैर्न वासोभिर्नान्यदानेन भारत। प्राप्नुवन्ति नराः श्रेयो यथा ह्यन्नप्रदाः प्रभो॥
en: Men cannot, by gifts of gold and dresses and of other things, win that happiness which givers of food succeed in wining, O you of great power.

sa: कौमुदे शुक्लपक्षे तु योऽन्नदानं करोत्युत। स संतरति दुर्गाणि प्रेत्य चानन्त्यमश्नुते॥
en: That man, who makes gifts of food in light half of the month of Kartika, succeeds in getting over every difficulty here and acquires endless happiness hereafter.

sa: भीष्म उवाच हन्त ते वर्तयिष्यामि यथावद् भरतर्षभ। गदतस्तन्ममाघेह शृणु सत्यपराक्रम॥
en: Bhishma said I shall, O chief of Bharata's race. relate to you this subject. Listen to ine, O you of unbaffled prowess, as I speak to you.

sa: अल्पोऽपि तादृशो दायो भवत्युत महाफलः। तृषिताय च ते दत्तं हृदयेनानसूयता॥
en: Even a small gift, made under the circumstances laid down, yields great fruits. You have given a little water with a sincere heart to a thirsty man.

sa: यश्चैवमुत्पादयते यश्चैनं त्रायते भयात्। यश्चास्य कुरुते वृत्तिं सर्वं ते पितरस्त्रयः॥
en: He who procreates a person, he who rescues a person, and he who assigns the means of livelihood to a person, are considered as the three fathers.

sa: विपरीतश्च मे शत्रुर्नियम्यश्च भवेन्नरः। पितृवृत्तेषु चाहःसु पुत्राणां श्राद्धकर्मणि॥ सुहृदां चैव सर्वेषां यावदस्य चिकीर्षितम्। ततः स राजा कौरव्यो धृतराष्ट्रो महामनाः॥ ब्राह्मणेभ्यो यथार्हेभ्यो ददौ वित्तान्यनेकशः।
en: He, on the other hand, who treats him otherwise, is my enemy. Such a man should certainly be punished by me. On days of performing the rites ordained for the Pitris, as also in the Shraddhas performed for his sons and all well-wishers, the great Kuru king Dhritarashtra, gave away to Brahmanas, as each deserved immense quantity of wealth after his heart.

sa: एकविंशे तु दिवसे यो भुङ्क्ते ह्येकभोजनम्॥ सदा द्वादशमासान् वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्। लोकमौशनसं दिव्यं शक्रलोकं च गच्छति॥ अश्विनोर्मरुतां चैव सुखेष्वभिरतः सदा।
en: That man who having fasted for twenty days, takes a single meal on the (wenty first day, and acts thus for a full year, pouring libations every day on his sacred fire, acquires the regions of Ushanas and Shakra, of the Ashvins and the Maruts, and lives there in uninterrupted happiness of great measure.

sa: ब्रह्मर्षयो विमानस्था ब्रह्मलोकचराश्च ये॥ कासन्ते दर्शनं तुभ्यं दिवं व्रज द्विजर्षभ।
en: The twice-bom Rishis who live in the regions of Brahma, seated on their cars, are anxious to see you. O foremost of twice-born persons, go to Heaven.

sa: यस्तु चोरयते तैलं नरो मोहसमन्वितः। सोऽपि राजन् मृतो जन्तुस्तैलपायी प्रजायते॥
en: That inan, king, who through stupefaction of the understanding, steals oil, is born, after renouncing this body, as an animal who lives upon oil as his form.

sa: कर्मभिश्चापि सुशुभैः सुव्रता ऋषयस्तथा। सशरीरा हि तान् यान्ति ब्राह्मणाः शुभबुद्धयः॥
en: Rishis observe excellent vows, by means of their deeds of virtue and piety and Brahmanas of righteous souls, succeed in going there in even their human bodies.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच गान्धार्यहमनुज्ञातः स्वयं पित्रा महात्मना। युधिष्ठिरस्यानुमते गन्तास्मि नचिराद् वनम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Gandhari, I have received the permission of my great sire. With the permission of Yudhishthira (next obtained), I shall soon retire into the forest.

sa: अहिंसेति प्रतिज्ञेयं यदि वक्ष्याम्यतः परम्। शक्यं बहुविधं कर्तुं भवता कार्यदूषणम्॥
en: This is the proposition, viz., No destruction (of living creatures-If I say anything further, then various kinds of faulty actions are capable of being done by you.

sa: क्रौञ्चो जीवति वर्षे तु ततो जायति चीरकः। ततो निधनमापन्नो मानुषत्वमुपाश्नुते॥
en: Having assumed that form he has to live in it for two years. Renouncing that form at the conclusion of that period, he regains the human forin.

sa: न ब्राह्मणविरोधेन शक्या शास्तुं वसुन्धरा। ब्राह्मणा हि महात्मानो देवानामपि देवताः॥
en: Kshatriyas are incapable of ruling the Earth without securing the good will of Brahmanas. are The Brahmana are great. They are the deities of the very deities.

sa: अरुन्धती तु तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वाङ्गोपचितं शुभम्। भवितारो भवन्तो वै नैवमित्यब्रवीदृषीन्॥
en: Seeing that mendicant whose limbs were all well-developed and beautiful, Arundhati exclaimed, addressing the Rishis, None of you will ever be able to show such wellgrown features.

sa: दृष्टपूर्वः स बहुशो राजन् सम्पतता मया। महेन्द्रसदने राजा तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषः॥
en: On many occasions, while visiting the region of Indra, O king, I saw that monarch, whose sins had all been consumed by penances, living in Indra's palace.

sa: मया ह्येता ह्यनुज्ञाताः पूर्वमासन् कृते युगे। ततोऽहमनुनीतो वै ब्रह्मणा पद्मयोनिना॥
en: Formerly in the golden age, I had expressed my approval of these creatures, Afterwards Brahman, sprung from the primeval lotus, requested me (to show kindness towards kine).

sa: यथा वेदाः स्वधीताश्च यथा चेन्द्रियसंयमः। सर्वत्यागो यथा चेह तथा दानमनुत्तमम्॥
en: As the Vedas when well-studied, as the controlling of the senses, as a life of universal Renunciation, so is gift which is fraught with very superior merit.

sa: गोकुलस्य तृषार्तस्य जलार्थे वसुधाधिप। उत्पादयति यो विघ्नं तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should o king, know that man to be guilty of Brahmanicide who puts impediments in the way of thirsty kine while engaged in satisfying that thirst.

sa: क्रतुभिश्चोपवासैश्च त्रिदिवं याति भारत। लभते च शिवं ज्ञानं फलपुष्पप्रदो नरः॥
en: By celebrating sacrifices and observing fasts, one goes to the celestial region, O Bharata. The man who gives away fruits and flowers succeeds in gaining sacred knowledge.

sa: शरीरं च जहात्येवं निरुच्छ्वासश्च दृश्यते। स निरुष्मा निरुच्छ्वासो नि:श्रीको हतचेतनः॥
en: It is thus that the wind leaves the body. Then is seen breathlessness. The man then becomes destitute of heat, of breath, of beauty, and of consciousness.

sa: भीष्म उवाच छत्रोपानहमेतत् तु सूर्येणैतत् प्रवर्तितम्। पुण्यमेतदभिख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत॥
en: Bhishma said This custom of giving umbrella and shoes was introduced by the Sun. O descendant of Bharata, these gifts are regarded meritorious in the three worlds.

sa: तस्य कृष्णो ददौ हृष्टो बहुरत्नं विशेषतः। तथान्ये वृष्णिशार्दूला नाम चास्याकरोत् प्रभुः॥ पितुस्तव महाराज सत्यसंधो जनार्दनः। परिक्षीणे कुले यस्माज्जातोऽयमभिमन्युजः॥ परिक्षिदिति नामास्य भवत्वित्यब्रवीत् तदा। सोऽवर्धते यथाकालं पिता तव जनाधिप॥ मनःप्रह्लादनश्चासीत् सर्वलोकस्य भारत। मासजातस्तु ते वीर पिता भवति भारत॥ अथाजग्मुः सुबहुलं रत्नमादाय पाण्डवाः। तान् समीपगताञ्श्रुत्वा निर्ययुर्वृष्णिपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Rejoicing greatly, Krishna made gifts to the child of many valuable gems. The other chiefs of the Vrishni-race, did the same. Then the powerful Janardana, firmly following truth, bestowed a name on the infant who was your father, O monarch. Since this child of Abhimanyu has been born at a time when this family has become nearly extinct, let his name be Parikshit.' This is what he said. Then your father, O king, began to grow, and please all the people, O Bharata. When your father was month old, O hero, the Pandavas returned to heir capital, bringing with them abundant riches. Hearing that the Pandavas were near, those foremost ones of the Vrishni-race went out.

sa: गुरूणीति विदित्वाथ न ग्राह्याण्यत्रिरब्रवीत्। न स्महे मन्दविज्ञाना न स्महे मन्दबुद्धयः॥
en: Atri took up some of those figs, and finding them heavy refused to take them. He said, We are not shorn of knowledge. We are not fools.

sa: श्रूयते हि पुरा कल्पे नृणां व्रीहिपयः पशुः। येनायजन्त यज्वानः पुण्यलोकपरायणाः॥
en: It is heard that in the former Aeon persons, desirous of acquiring regions of merit hereafter, celebrated sacrifices with seeds, regarding such animals as dedicated by them.

sa: घ्राण जिह्वा तथा श्रोत्रं वाङ्मनो बुद्धिरेव च। न रूपाण्यधिगच्छन्ति चक्षुस्तान्यधिगच्छति॥
en: The nose, the tongue. the ear also, the skin, the mind and the understanding, never succeed in apprehending colours. It is the eye alone which apprchends them.

sa: यथा महार्णवे क्षिप्त आमलोष्टो विनश्यति। तथा दुश्चरितं सर्वं पराभावाय कल्पते॥
en: That man who speaks ill of the Brahmanas soon meets with discomfiture, even as a clod of unbaked earth, meets with destruction when thrown into the sea.

sa: आढ्याश्च बलवन्तश्च यौवनस्थाश्च भारत। ये वै जितेन्द्रिया धीरास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who master their senses though they are rich in worldly possessions, endued with robust constitution and gifted with youthful vigour, succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: कीर्तयानो नरो ह्येतान् मुच्यते सर्वकिल्विषैः। स्तुवंश्च प्रतिनन्दंश्च मुच्यते सर्वतो भयात्॥
en: The man, who takes the names of these, becomes purged of all his sins. By singing their praises and pleasing them, one becomes freed from every fear.

sa: औरभ्रमुत्तरायोगे यस्तु मांसं प्रयच्छति। स पितॄन् प्रीणयति वै प्रेत्य चानन्त्यमश्नुते॥
en: One who makes, under the constellation Uttara, a gift of mutton, pleases the departed manes by such an act and acquires unending merit in the next world.

sa: भीष्म उवाच महर्षेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा नहुषो दुःखकर्शितः। स चिन्तयामास तदा सहामात्यपुरोहितः॥
en: Bhishma continued Hearing these words of the great Rishi, Nahusha became stricken with great sorrow. With his ministers and priest he began to think on the matter.

sa: ततः स रथमास्थाय ज्वलनार्कसमद्युतिम्। अब्रवीद् वीर्य सम्मोहात् को वास्ति सदृशो मम।। धैर्यवैिर्यशः शौर्यैर्विक्रमेणौजसापि वा। तद्वाक्यान्ते चान्तरिक्षो वागुवाचाशरीरिणी॥ न त्वं मूढ विजानीषे ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियाद् वरम्। सहितो ब्राह्मणेनेह क्षत्रियः शास्ति वै प्रजाः॥
en: Riding then on his car which was effulgent like fire or the Sun, the king, blinded by his great prowess, said, Who, indeed, is there who can be considered as my equal in patience and energy, in fame and heroism, in prowess and strength? After he had uttered these words, an invisible voice in the sky, said, O ignorant wretch, do you not know that the Brahmana is superior to the Kshatriya? The Kshatriya, helped by the Brahman, rules all creatures.

sa: एवमुक्ते तदा तेन दम्पती तौ जहर्षतुः। प्रत्यब्रूतां च तमृषिमेवमस्त्विति भारत॥
en: consort to serve Thus addressed by the Rishi, the king and the queen became filled with delight, O Bharata, and answered him, saying-Be it so, O Rishi.

sa: अहान्यस्तमयान्तानि उदयान्ता च शर्वरी। सुखस्यान्तं सदा दुःखं दुःखस्यान्तं सदा सुखम्॥१८
en: Days end with the sun's setting and Nights with the sun's rising. The end of pleasure is always sorrow, and the end of sorrow is always pleasure.

sa: नाहं शोचामि तनयं हतं पन्नगनन्दिनि। पतिमेव तु शोचामि यस्यानिध्यमिदं कृतम्॥
en: O daughter of the Snake-Chief, I do not grieve for my killed son! I grieve for only my husband who has received this hospitality form his son.

sa: यद्यस्मासु प्रलीनेषु तर्पणं प्राणधारणम्। भोगान् भुडक्ते भवान् सत्यं यथैतन्मन्यते तथा॥ अथवास्मासु लीनेषु तिष्ठत्सु विषयेषु च। यदि संकल्पमात्रेण भुङ्क्ते भोगान् यथार्थवत्॥
en: If, when we are no more, there be gratification and support of life, and a continuation of your enjoyments, then what you think would be true; or, if, when we are absorbed and objects are existing, you can't have your enjoyments by your desire alone, as truly as you have them with our help.

sa: विप्रवादाः सुबहवः श्रूयन्ते पुत्रकारिताः। अत्र नो मुह्यतां राजन् संशयं छेत्तुमर्हसि॥
en: It is known that disputes frequently take place about sons. You should, O king, remove the doubts of our mind. Indeed, we are stupefied about this subject.

sa: अपि पापकृतां राज्ञां प्रतिगृह्णन्ति साधवः। पृथिवीं नान्यदिच्छन्ति पावनं जननी यथा॥
en: The virtuous accept gifts of earth only and no other thing from sinful kings. Like one's mother, earth, when given away, purifies the giver and the taker.

sa: प्रमार्जन्ती च गात्राणि मम वै मधुसूदन। दैन्यमालम्ब्य जननी इदमाह सुरोत्तम॥
en: Gently patting my body, o destroyer of Madhu, my mother, adopting a tone of great humility, addressed me in the following words, O best of the gods.

sa: उचुश्चैनं तथा वाक्यं मानुषाणां त्वमीश्वरः॥ असिना धर्मगर्भेण पालयस्व प्रजा इति।
en: At the time of giving it to Manu, they said-You are the lord of all men. Protect all creatures with this sword having religion within its womb.

sa: यथा वेदयते कश्चिदोदनं वायसो ह्यदन्। एवं सर्वाणि कर्माणि स्वभावस्यैव लक्षणम्॥
en: As a crow, while eating some food, announces the presences of that food by its repeated cawing, similarly all our acts only proclaim the indications of Nature.

sa: अतीत हसते रौद्रस्रासयन् नयनैर्जनम्। जागर्ति चैव स्वपिति जृम्भते च यथासुखम्॥
en: Endued with dreadful fierceness, he sometimes laughs loudly, frightening all creatures with his eyes. He sometimes sleeps and sometimes remains awake, and sometimes yawns as he pleases.

sa: ननु नाम त्वया मोक्षः कृत्स्नः पञ्चशिखाच्छ्रुतः। सोपाय: सोपनिषदः सोपासङ्गः सनिश्चयः॥
en: Have you heard the religion of Liberation in all its bearings from the lips of Panchashikha, together with its means, it methods, its practises, and its conclusion?

sa: अपाणित्वाद् वयं ब्रह्मन् कण्टकं नोद्धरामहे। जन्तूनुच्चावचानङ्गे दशतो न कषाम वा॥
en: See, O Brahmana, I cannot get out this thorn that has entered my body, or crush these insects and worms that are biting and paining me greatly.

sa: तस्य प्रशासतो राज्यं धर्मेणामित्रघातिनः। नानृता वाक् समभवन्मनो दुष्टं न चाभवत्॥
en: As long as that destroyer of enemies continued to rule his kingdom piously, no falsehood ever escaped his lips and no evil thought ever entered his mind.

sa: दृष्टवान् नारदो यत्तु देवं नारायणं हरिम्। नूनमेतद्ध्यनुमतं तस्य देवस्य सूतज॥
en: That Narada was able to see of Narayana, otherwise called Hari, was owing, O son of Suta, to the especial favour of that divine and powerful Lord.

sa: तस्मात् पितुर्वचः कार्यं न विचार्यं कदाचन। पातकान्यपि पूयन्ते पितुः शासनकारिणः॥
en: Hence, the commands of the father should be obeyed without ever questioning them in the least. The very sins of one who obeys his father are cleansed.

sa: पश्यामि लोकानमलाञ्छुचीन् ब्राह्मणयायिनः। तेषु मे तात गन्तव्यमह्नाय च चिराय च॥
en: I see many regions of beatitude waiting for me who have respectfully followed the Brahmanas. Very soon shall I go to these regions for good, O son.

sa: देवासुरमुनीनां तु यच्च गुह्यं सनातनम्। गुहायां निहितं ब्रह्म दुर्विज्ञेयं मुनेरपि॥
en: You are always a mystery with the gods, the Asuras, and the ascetics. Brahma is concealed in a cave. The very ascetics cannot see or know him.

sa: स पश्यति यथान्यायं स्पर्शान् स्पृशति वा विभो। बुध्यमानो यथापूर्वमखिलेनेह भारत॥
en: The Subtile Soul, during sleep continues to see and touch all objects of touch, O king, and get other perceptions, as well as when it is awake.

sa: यथा शून्ये पुरागारे भिक्षुरेकां निशां वसेत्। तथाहं त्वच्छरीरेऽस्मिन्निमां वत्स्यामि शर्वरीम्॥
en: As a person of the mendicant order lives for only one night in an emphy house, similarly, I shall live for this one night in your body.

sa: आत्मना विप्रहीणानि काष्ठकुड्यसमानि तु। विनश्यन्ति न संदेहः फेना इव महार्णवे॥
en: Disassociated from the Soul, the senses are like pieces of wood, and are, forsooth, destroyed like the forth that is seen on the bosom of the ocean.

sa: व्यास उवाच तेऽनुशिष्टा भगवता देवाः सर्षिगणास्तथा। नमस्कृत्वा भगवते जग्मुर्देशान् यथेप्सितान्॥
en: Vyasa said Thus commanded by the great God, the gods with all the Rishis bowed their heads to him and then proceeded to the places they desired.

sa: एवं सति कुत: संज्ञा प्रेत्यभावे पुनर्भवेत्। प्रतिसम्मिश्रिते जीवेऽगृह्यमाणे च सर्वतः॥
en: Likewise, the individual Soul which is characterised by qualities, is received into the Universal Soul, and when all its attributes disappear, how can it be differently mentioned?

sa: इन्द्रियाणां तु सर्वेषामीश्वरं मन उच्यते। एतद् विशन्ति भूतानि सर्वाणीह महायशः॥
en: Indeed, the Mind is said to be the Lord of all the Senses. O you of great fame, these are all the twenty elements in the Universe.

sa: भृगुरुवाच प्रजाविसर्ग विविधं मानसो मानसासृजत्। संरक्षणार्थं भूतानां सृष्टं प्रथमतो जलम्॥
en: Bhrigu said The great Manasa (in his form of Brahman) created the various objects by his Will. For the protection of all creatures, he first created water.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अनेकान्तं बहुद्वारं धर्ममाहुर्मनीषिणः। किंनिमित्तं भवेदत्र तन्मे बूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said The wise hold that duty or virtue has many ends and numerous doors. Tell me, O grandfather what however are the decisions in this matter.

sa: एवं स चिन्तयित्वा तु भगवान् मधुसूदनः॥ रूपाण्यनेकान्यसृजत् प्रादुर्भावे भवाय सः।
en: Having thought thus, the illustrious killer of Madhu created various forms in his mind in which to appear from time to time for performing the proposed task.

sa: सुशीघ्रमपि धावन्तं विधानमनुधावति। शेते सह शयानेन येन येन यथा कृतम्॥
en: The acts that one does, follow him even when he runs fast. Whatever act one does, lie down with the doer when the doer lays himself down.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच पार्थिवं धातुमासाद्य शारीरोऽग्निः कथं प्रभो। अवकाशविशेषेण कथं वर्तयतेऽनिलः॥
en: How docs bodily fire or heat, entering the body, live there? How also does the wind, getting space for itself, cause the body to move and work?

sa: चक्षुषी नासिकाकर्णी त्वक् जिह्वेति च पञ्चमी। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थानां ज्ञानानि कवयो विदुः॥
en: The two eyes, the nose, the two ears, the skin, and the tongue, are the senses. These, the learned hold, exist for perception of their various objects.

sa: अग्रतश्चाभवत् प्रीतो ववन्दे चापि पादयोः। तं पादयोर्निपतितं दृष्ट्वा सव्येन पाणिना॥
en: With a cheerful heart he appeared before his progenitor and adored his feet. Seeing Mahadeva prostrated at his feet, Brahman took him up with his left hand.

sa: इक्ष्वाकुणा च कथितो व्याप्य लोकानवस्थितः। गमिष्यति क्षयान्त च पुनर्नारायणं नृप॥
en: Promulgated by Ikshvaku, that religion overspreads the whole world. When the universal destruction sets in, it will once more return to Narayana and be merged in Him.

sa: पर्वतानां भवान् मेरुर्नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः। वसिष्ठस्त्वमृषीणां च ग्रहाणां सूर्य उच्यते॥
en: You are Meru amongst mountains, you are the Moon among all luminaries of the sky, you are Vashishtha amongst Rishis, yon are the Sun among the planets.

sa: भीष्म उवाच प्रवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मो यथा समुपलभ्यते। तेषां विज्ञाननिष्ठानामन्यत्तत्वं न रोचते॥
en: Bhishma said more Persons who perform acts consider the performance of acts highly. Likewise, those who are devoted to Knowledge do not regard anything other than Knowledge.

sa: तस्याश्चायं मया राजन् फलमभ्येत्य याचितः। विकृतेन च मे दत्तं विशुद्धनान्तरात्मना॥
en: Going to him, O king, I begged of him the reward of that act. With a pure heart, Vikrita made a gift to me of that reward.

sa: सत्त्वं रजस्तमः कालः कर्म बुद्धिश्च भारत। मनःषष्ठानि चैतेषु ईश्वरः समकल्पयत्॥
en: Having created these, the Supreme God, O Bharata, united with them the qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance, Time, Consciousness of functions, and Mind forming the sixth.

sa: सरितां सागरो भर्ता यथा वेलामिवोर्मिवान्। इति भावगता बुद्धिर्भावे मनसि वर्तते॥
en: As the lord of rivers, viz., the Ocean, always keeps within his bounds, so the Understanding, which exists united with the (three) states, exists in the Mind.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच बहवः पुरुषाः पुत्र त्वया ये समुदाहृताः। एवमेतदतिक्रान्तं द्रष्टव्यं नैवमित्यपि॥
en: Brahman said O son, many are those Souls of whom you speak. The one Soul, however, of whom I am thinking, transcends all Souls and is invisible.

sa: यथाऽऽकाशान्तरं प्राप्य चन्द्रमा भ्राजते पुनः। तद्वल्लिङ्गान्तरं प्राप्य शरीरी भ्राजते पुनः॥
en: As gaining another point in the sky, the moon begins to shine once more, similarly the soul, acquiring a new body, begins to manifest itself once more.

sa: एवमेष महान् धर्म आद्यो राजन् सनातनः। दुर्विज्ञेयो दुष्करश्च सात्वतैर्धार्यते सदा॥
en: Thus, O king, this foremost of religions is primeval and eternal. Incapable of being understood easily and highly difficult of being pervaded by the quality of godness.

sa: आत्मच्छन्देन वर्तन्ते नार्यो मन्मथचोदिताः॥ न च दह्यन्ति गच्छन्त्यः सुतप्तैरपि पांसुभिः।
en: When moved by the god of love women become very whimsical. Then they do not feel any pain even they walk over a desert of burning sand.

sa: न लिप्यते फलैश्चापि पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा। कर्मात्मा त्वपरो योऽसौ मोक्षबन्धैः स युज्यते॥
en: The acting Soul is different. That Soul is sometimes engaged in acts and when it succeeds in renouncing acts acquires Liberation or identity with the Supreme Soul.

sa: यदाश्वयूं स्नुषा वृद्धां परिचारेण योक्ष्यते।११२।। पुत्रश्च पितरं मोहात् प्रेषयिष्यति कर्मसु। ब्राह्मणैः कारयिष्यन्ति वृषला: पादधावनम्॥ शूद्राश्च ब्राह्मणी भार्यामुपयास्यन्ति निर्भया:। वियोनिषु विमोक्ष्यन्ति बीजानि पुरुषा तदा॥ संकरं कांस्यभाण्डैश्च बलिं चैव कुपात्रकैः। चातुर्वण्र्यं यदा कृत्स्नममर्यादं भविष्यति॥ एकैकस्ते तदा पाशः क्रमशः परिमोक्ष्यते।
en: When the daughter-in-law will make the aged mother-in-law work, when the son, through delusion, will order his father to work for him. When Shudras will have their feet washed by Brahmanas and know fearlessly the women of twice-born ones, when men will know forbidden women, when the refuse of houses will begin to be carried upon plates and vessels made of white brass, and when sacrificial offerings intended for the gods will begin to be carried upon impure vessels, when all the four castes will transgress all restrictions, then these fetters of yours will begin one by one, to loosen.

sa: तस्य स्वादुतयानस्य न प्रभूतं चकार सः। व्यगमच्चाप्यहःशेषं ततः संध्यागमत् पुनः॥
